name: chat-app

scripts.build: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend

comment: Backend runtime deps are duplicated here (not just in backend/package.json) so Vercel installs them at the repo root and can bundle api/index.mjs, which imports backend/src. Keep versions in sync with backend/package.json.
